responsibility: Defines the extra tree codes introduced by the C-family front ends beyond the generic GCC tree set, such as C_MAYBE_CONST_EXPR, EXCESS_PRECISION_EXPR, C-family loop/branch statement nodes, and CONCEPT_DECL. This .def file is declarative metadata used by GCC’s code-generation machinery and tree infrastructure so that parsers, dumping, pretty-printing, and lowering code can recognize and manipulate these front-end-specific node kinds consistently.
same_name_distinction: Declarative tree-code definition file for the c-common stem: unlike c-common.cc, it contains no runtime support logic, and unlike c-common.h, it does not declare APIs; it enumerates C-family-specific tree node kinds such as FOR_STMT, WHILE_STMT, and CONCEPT_DECL for generated tree infrastructure.
